name: Macaroni and Cheese
summary: Boiled macaroni bound in a white sauce with cheese and baked under buttered crumbs.
ingredients: 1 cup macaroni, broken in short lengths

equipment.help: The browning at the end is the only part that differs.
equipment.label: Oven

steps.title: Boil the macaroni
steps.body: Cook the macaroni in plenty of salted boiling water until just tender.

steps.title: Drain it
steps.body: Drain and rinse with cold water so it stops cooking.

steps.title: Start the white sauce
steps.body: Melt the butter, stir in the flour, and cook the paste for a minute without letting it colour.

steps.title: Add the milk
steps.body: Pour the milk in a little at a time, stirring hard, until the sauce is smooth and thick. Season with the salt and pepper.
steps.note: Adding the milk slowly is what keeps the sauce from going lumpy.

steps.title: Melt in the cheese
steps.body: Take the pan off the heat and stir the grated cheese through until it melts.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Mix the macaroni into the sauce and turn it all into a buttered dish.

steps.title: Butter the crumbs
steps.body: Rub the tablespoon of butter through the crumbs and scatter them over the top.

steps.title: Heat a gas oven to 400°F
steps.body: Use the upper third of a gas oven, where the top heat browns crumbs well.

steps.title: Heat an electric oven to 400°F
steps.body: If the crumbs are still pale at the end, give it two minutes under the grill.

steps.title: Heat a convection oven to 375°F
steps.body: The fan browns crumbs quickly, so drop the heat and watch the last few minutes.

steps.title: Bake until brown
steps.body: Bake until the top is brown and the sauce bubbles at the edges.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Let it settle for five minutes, then serve from the dish.
